properties.name: A project's export path is recorded once, in .reflow2.toml, and every writing call, the Stop hook, init and the CI gate read it; init --check names every step; search hits carry status and kind
properties.rationale: The class, not the instance: the export path had no owner, so each part found it its own way (fact:root-cause-the-export-path-has-no-owner-so-writes-the-hook-and-init-disagree-2026-10-06). One committed record closes it for writes, the hook, init and the gate at once, and would have prevented the 2026-10-02 and 2026-09-18 occurrences of the same class. MCP projects are unchanged unless they add the key.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: .reflow2.toml takes an optional [export] path; a file with only it leaves the folder a local design. call_export.rs reads it after --export-to, so loop_status's export standing does too; loop_nudge's Stop hook reads it and leaves the export to the writes; reflow2_init adopts an existing export (an MCP configuration's --export-to, or a committed export of this design) and records it on the terminal route; reflow2_check.py defaults to it. init --check now names the record, .gitattributes and the merge driver, and a test fails if a run touches a file the preview did not name. search_design hits carry status and kind.
